{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
customer_age_count_neg1 = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {customer_age_count_neg1}')

# Check revenue for thousands separators
print('\nFirst 5 values of revenue (as string):')
print(df['revenue'].head(5))

# Also check if any revenue values are 999999.99 (possible QA orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check status values
total_orders = len(df)
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f'\nTotal orders: {total_orders}')
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Check channel distribution
df_channel = df['channel'].value_counts()
print(f'\nChannel distribution:\n{df_channel}')

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
df_segment_channel = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f'\nCustomer segment by channel:\n{df_segment_channel}')"}
